name: Time-dependent NeRF with Continuous Camera Motion
aliases: Continuous Optimization of NeRF and poses
Joint Optimization of Neural Radiance Fields and Continuous Camera Motion
Time-dependent NeRF with Continuous Camera Motion — Joint Optimization of Neural Radiance Fields and Continuous Camera Motion
definition: A method that jointly optimizes a time-dependent NeRF and continuous camera motion from monocular video by representing the scene as local SDF and appearance fields at each time step, constrained by consistency losses, rather than a single global NeRF with noisy initial poses.
